claim_boundary: This one-acetone gas-phase GFN2-xTB external-field comparison is a no-runtime-QM physical screen only. It contains no implicit solvent, xTB COSMO/GBSA/ALPB/CPCM-X calculation, experimental solvation value, target calibration, force/PES certificate, total-solvation prediction, or public Route-2 profile. A pass can admit only the next common-energy/PCM coupling investigation; it cannot establish chemical accuracy.

candidate_identity.role: candidate frozen self-consistent gas electronic energy functional, pending this and later common-energy PCM gates
excluded_interfaces: xTB --alpha output, which reports D4 atomic polarizabilities rather than the required response tensor
xTB --efield, unavailable for GFN2-xTB in the installed 6.7.1 executable

finite_field_protocol.construction: For requested signed field s*h*e_j at the frozen geometry centroid C, write a +q point charge at C-s*D*e_j and a -q point charge at C+s*D*e_j, with q=h*D^2/2. Positions are in bohr and gamma=1e8 invokes the xTB documented real-point-charge limit. This is an asymptotically uniform external perturbation; no bare point-charge energy is spliced into the xTB energy.
finite_field_protocol.dipole_tensor: alpha_ij=[mu_i(+h e_j)-mu_i(-h e_j)]/(2h), using xTB total molecular dipoles in e bohr
finite_field_protocol.uniformity_proxy: (max_A |R_A-C|/D)^2; this is an a-priori geometry-scale diagnostic, not a fitted correction

scientific_falsification_gates.interpretation: These are pre-execution rejection gates for gross gas-response error against the existing fixed omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD finite-field reference. They are not a solvation-accuracy claim; passing still requires a same-kernel electronic/continuum scalar, source-complete nonpolar physics, force/PES gates, full historical FreeSolv10 and 12-record/ten-functional-group panels, multisolvent validation, and an independent blind set.

decision_rule: If any numerical gate fails, the embedded-pair interface is invalid for this screen and GFN2-xTB is not admitted. If any scientific gate fails, reject frozen gas GFN2-xTB as the V0 electronic candidate; do not rescale its response, alter the published parameters, change field steps/pair geometry, add a correction, or select an implicit-solvent construction from the result. If all gates pass, admit only a subsequent same-energy, xTB-kernel-compatible continuum investigation. Do not run an accuracy panel from this screen.
